old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-g2aq","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p19p: Python EDHOC reference impl has same raw-concat TH_2 bug","description":"Discovered during review of Rust EDHOC transcript_2 fix. The Python reference implementation at python/src/lichen/crypto/edhoc.py computes TH_2 via raw byte concatenation (g_y + h_msg1) at two call sites: EdhocInitiator._process_message_2 line 389 and EdhocResponder._process_message_1 line 598. Per RFC 9528 Section 5.3.2, TH_2 = H(G_Y, H(message_1)) where the input is a CBOR Sequence, meaning both G_Y and H(message_1) must be CBOR bstr-encoded before hashing. This is the same bug the Rust commit fixed.
